compiled_state.description:
Write tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh covering all done-definition behaviors before the script exists (RED gate). Tests must fail until Task 2 is complete.

Test cases required:
1. test_script_exists — assert script file is present (fails RED)
2. test_executable_bit — assert chmod +x is set (fails RED)
3. test_all_provenanced_exits_0 — mock git log emitting only DSO-Story-Merge commits + mock gh api returning passing per-branch-review check; expect exit 0
4. test_direct_commit_exits_nonzero — introduce one commit with no DSO-Story-Merge trailer and no linked sub-branch PR; expect non-zero exit, SHA reported on stdout/stderr, and integration-review scope file written
5. test_backoff_on_429 — mock gh api returning HTTP 429 twice then success; assert sleep calls use exponential backoff (2s, 4s) and final call succeeds
6. test_budget_exhausted — configure budget ceiling to a small value (e.g. 3) via env override; mock enough commits to exceed it; expect non-zero exit with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED in output
7. test_sha_pr_cache_hit — run verifier twice; assert gh api is called only once per SHA (cache prevents re-query on rerun)
8. test_squash_merge_trailer_resolution — merge commit with DSO-Story-Merge trailer but individual task-commit SHAs that have no linked PR; verifier treats the story as provenanced via the trailer signal

Follow the test structure in tests/scripts/test-resolve-session-branch.sh: mktemp tmpdir, mock bin/ directory, PATH override, source tests/lib/assert.sh, print_summary.
